display_name: lemonade-burn LFM2 (our MoE engine: Burn + CubeCL, GGUF Q4_0)

support.note: Experts resident on any wgpu (Vulkan) card within --gpu-budget-mb; the rest of the model runs on the CPU. {device} is a LB_WGPU_DEVICE spec: default, discrete:N or integrated:N.

notes: lemonade-burn (github.com/festeraeb/lemonade-burn, branch lfm2-cubecl): LFM2 / LFM2-MoE loaded straight from a GGUF (Q4_0 matrices, Q6_K tied head); {model} is the .gguf path and tokenizer.json must sit beside it (LiquidAI's tokenizer.json from the model repo).
The server is built with `cargo build --release -p lb-server --features gpu`; without the feature it still serves, all on CPU (drop --gpu from args).

NautiBurn scrape hook built in: every request writes a schema_version-1 scrape file to NAUTIBURN_SCRAPE_DIR, and the same directory feeds the expert placement at the next load (the scraper rule is met by the engine itself).

Step-2 state (2026-10-31): CPU path is a correctness reference (slow); GPU path runs only the resident experts. Prefetch from nautiburn-shadow, GPU attention/prefill and the native tokenizer are step 3 (docs/LFM2_CUBECL.md in the engine repo).
Not yet loaded through a generated backend; verified by a direct round trip to the server (see the engine repo's docs/LFM2_CUBECL.md).
